description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mallanda, Kothmale D/S Division, Nuwaraeliya District - Cad Mad No. 330300 and Others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and title classifications. The content focuses on land ownership, title registration, and property rights, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
